detail.longDescription: Upskilling in AI is just about the most productive thing you could do with your free time right now. With every day that passes, AI technology is making strides, and the demand for AI-related skills increases along with it. In fact, a Zapier survey found that 35% of enterprise leaders say AI skill gaps among their employees are a barrier to AI adoption at their company.
